# Peridot Dental Care

> A comprehensive dental clinic in Woodbridge offering general, surgical, restorative, cosmetic, and pediatric dentistry services with advanced diagnostic technology.

Peridot Dental Care is a full-service dental practice located in Woodbridge, Ontario, serving the Vaughan area. The clinic is staffed by experienced dentists including Dr. Elham Faghih Nasiri, Dr. Iman Sabetahd, and Dr. Ecaterina Manea, all with credentials from prestigious dental institutions and the Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario.
